---
title: "Tidy_Recovery_Data"
output: html_document
---

```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)


source("util/helpers.R")
```

## Daten laden
```{r data_load}
recovery_data <- load_data("recovery")
```

## Datenbereinigung
Da die Daten noch verschachtelt sind (leere Listen etc.), müssen diese noch noch bereinigt werden, damit wir die dann analysieren können:
```{r clean_data_structure}
 recovery_data <- sanitize_data_structure(recovery_data)
```

```{r}
naniar::miss_var_summary(recovery_data)
```
Analyse:
```{r}
no_skin_temp <- recovery_data %>% filter(is.na(score.skin_temp_celsius))
```
-> Datensatz sieht sonst gut aus -> NA imputieren mit Mittelwert

```{r}
recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  mutate(score.skin_temp_celsius = 
           replace_na(score.skin_temp_celsius,  median(score.skin_temp_celsius, na.rm = TRUE))) 
```

Einträge mit gleicher cycle_id würden entfernt
```{r remove_duplicates}
recovery_data <- recovery_data %>% distinct(cycle_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Feature Engineering
Variable umbennenen -> sprechender
```{r}
recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  rename(recovery_heart_rate_variability = score.hrv_rmssd_milli)
```

recovery_zone (Ampel) je nach recovery_score:
```{r feature_engineering}

recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_zone = case_when(
      score.recovery_score <= 33 ~ "red",    
      score.recovery_score <= 66 ~ "yellow", 
      TRUE                       ~ "green"  
    )
  )
```

Nur relevante Spalten selektieren:
```{r select_only_relevant_columns}
recovery_data_cleaned <- recovery_data %>%
  select( cycle_id, sleep_id,
         score.recovery_score, score.resting_heart_rate, score.spo2_percentage, 
         recovery_heart_rate_variability, score.skin_temp_celsius, recovery_zone)
```

Abspeichern:
```{r store_clean_data}
write_rds(recovery_data_cleaned, file = here("data", "cleaned_recovery_data.rds"))
```
